text:
alex_pm: Quick follow-up from todays all-hands Q&A  need concrete windows + acceptance criteria for: API batching primitives, Console delta rollout (canary->beta->GA), and Optimize suggestion phases. PMs need to finalize external notes.

tara_vp: Short answer: batching canary late-July, beta mid-Aug, GA Sept; Console internal canary next week, external beta ~3w after that, GA late-Aug; Optimize phase1 (read-only hints) in Sept, phase2 (opt-in apply) in Q4 pending audit/undo.

josh_engineering: Batching status: runtime PR merged to staging, perf harness running. Proposed canary 2025-07-22 -> 2025-07-29. Main risk: memory bump on older GPUs (T4). Draft acceptance checklist: p50 <= +5%, p95 <= +20%, no new 5xx classes, kv-cache delta <12%.

maya_prod: Console rollout plan: internal 10% canary 2025-07-09; expand to invited beta cohort ~2025-07-30 (15 customers); GA target 2025-08-26. Acceptance: per-route toggle, rollout dashboard, 72h no critical errors, support playbook published.

simon_support: Support needs a 1-page beta FAQ + a quick troubleshooting checklist before external beta. Also contact rota for on-call.

infra-bot: Canary ticket INF-4920 created. Window: 2025-07-22T08:00Z -> 2025-07-29T08:00Z. Alerts will post to #eng-oncall.

alex_pm: Actions: Maya publish beta list + acceptance doc by EOD; Josh push perf artifacts + compatibility notes by EOD Thurs; Simon draft FAQ by 2025-07-15. Leads, drop final dates in shared roadmap so I can lock customer comms.

tara_vp: If any blocker remains after perf runs we'll schedule a short leadership sync. Thanks, team. :thumbsup:
